relationships.subject: ACC-ACC callosal projection
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that activation of unilateral ACC evokes postsynaptic Ca2+ influx in contralateral ACC neurons.

relationships.subject: ACC-ACC callosal projection
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that an activated ACC-ACC pathway can reduce nociceptive thresholds and may partly contribute to affective behaviors.

key_findings: Direct glutamatergic (AMPA/kainate) projection exists between bilateral ACC.
Optogenetic activation of the ACC-ACC pathway lowers pain thresholds in male and female mice; inhibition reduces hyperalgesia in nerve injury.
